Subject: Next steps and revised MAP — Chronos Biotech (Q3 target)

Hi Samira,

Great to meet with you and the Chronos team earlier today — thanks for the candid run-through of the use cases and the timelines. Quick recap and proposed next steps (I drafted an initial MAP):

- Target close: end of Q3 (provisional) — we should lock a firm date once procurement confirms lead times.
- Key milestones I added to the MAP:
  • PO/contract signing (owner: Chronos procurement)
  • Security questionnaire + evidence (owner: Chronos security / Redwood security)
  • Pilot integration (owner: Chronos eng / Redwood solutions)
  • Acceptance + go-live (owner: Chronos product)
- Action items for Chronos: procurement timeline, SOC-2 snapshot, target users for pilot.
- Action items for Redwood: updated MAP with responsibilities, draft SOW template, pilot runbook.

I've attached the draft MAP (v1) to get us started. Please review and tell us any changes to owners or dates — we'll iterate to a v2 this week.

Next steps: can we set a 30-minute checkpoint next Thursday to confirm procurement windows? If that works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite and include Priyom (AM) to align on the pilot support model.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side after the internal sync: 

- Procurement will need a detailed procurement timeline (lead times for PO processing and legal review).
- Security wants the SOC-2 snapshot and an outline of data retention and access controls before pilot sign-off.
- Our preferred target close is still Q3 but we may need to push final sign-off to mid-Q3 depending on procurement queue.

I reviewed the MAP v1: good structure. Two requests for v2 please:
1) Add a row for "security evidence submission" with owner = Chronos security + Redwood security and an expected due date.
2) Split the pilot milestone into "integration" and "acceptance testing" so we can gate the go/no-go.

Can you send v2 with those changes and the target dates you propose? Also include a short note on what Redwood will deliver during the 4-week pilot.

Samira
